messages:
Nora (design): Quick sync — proposal for condensed console surfaces: make ghost/secondary buttons visually 32px so they align with the new condensed table row height. Keep physical hit area >=44px via invisible padding. Also, toasts are currently overlapping inline row actions on small widths; suggestion: render toasts above the toolbar but beneath modal overlays and default them non-interactive. Thoughts? :mag_right:

Ben (frontend): I like the alignment. Implementation plan: keep `height:32px` on the element, add a pseudo-element to expand the hit target to 44px so no layout shift. Will also add `pointer-events:none` to non-interactive toasts and a `--z-toast` token. Concern: token rename churn if we change compact spacing names.

Jia (a11y): Accessibility rules: visible control can be <44px as long as touch target >=44px and keyboard focus ring remains visible on the actual control. For toasts: use `role=\"status\"` + `aria-live=\"polite\"`. Do not move focus to toasts; interactive toasts must opt-in and be focusable with a clear keyboard close control.

Marco (infra): z-index suggestion: `--z-toolbar:700`, `--z-toast:850`, `--z-modal-overlay:1000`. Non-interactive toasts `pointer-events:none;` interactive variant `.toast--interactive { pointer-events:auto; tabindex:0 }`. I'll coordinate with releases so the token aliasing can be staged (avoid breaking Dedicated customers).

Ben (frontend): Snippet I will include in the PR:
```css
.btn-condensed { position: relative; height: 32px; }
.btn-condensed::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: -6px; bottom: -6px; /* expands to 44px */ }
.toast { z-index: var(--z-toast, 850); pointer-events: none; }
.toast--interactive { pointer-events: auto; }
```
Plus token aliasing mapping in `tokens/compact.json` so old names continue to work for one release.

Nora (design): Also a tiny microcopy tweak: change empty-state CTA label from "Try again" to "Retry" for consistency in the console. Not blocking for the button work but please include the copy change in the UI PR if easy.

Jia (a11y): Quick PR checklist: preserve 44px hit target, toasts use `role=\"status\"` and `aria-live=\"polite\"`, interactive toasts are focusable and return focus to trigger on close, Escape key behavior unchanged for modal dismiss. I'll run VoiceOver / NVDA checks on the branch.

Ben (frontend): Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/1417 (WIP) includes CSS patch, token aliases, and a tiny visual/regression test for condensed table + action strip. Ping me for reviews.

Nora (design): Plan: canary in staging, run visual + a11y checks, then merge after one design + one a11y signoff. Thanks all! :rocket:

notify-bot: CI started for branch/condensed-buttons. Visual-regress and a11y checks queued.
